list_calls.title: List call history
list_calls.description: List the call history across the account's widgets, newest first, with each call's status (new, scheduled, in-progress, ringing, completed, manager-failed, user-failed, failed, cancelled), visitor number, manager, tags, notes, form fields, UTM and geo data, plus meta.count for paging. Filter by date range, widget, user, tag, status, phone number or install URL. Use get_call for one call by id.
list_calls.notes: The API key needs the calls.view scope. CallPage accepts several values per array filter; this tool sends one value per filter.

date_from.description: Only calls created at or after this Unix timestamp (seconds).

date_to.description: Only calls created at or before this Unix timestamp (seconds).

widget_id.description: Only calls from this widget (sent as widget_ids[]).

user_id.description: Only calls handled by this user (sent as user_ids[]).

status.description: Only calls in this status (sent as statuses[]).

tag_id.description: Only calls carrying this tag (sent as tag_ids[]).

incoming_number_id.description: Only calls to this incoming number (sent as incoming_number_ids[]).

call_id.description: Only the call with this id (sent as call_id[]).

phone_number.description: Only calls with this visitor phone number, E.164 format, e.g. +48123123123.

url.description: Only calls from the widget installed at this URL.

display_hidden.description: 1 (CallPage default) to include hidden calls, 0 to exclude them.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (CallPage default 100).

output.description: Calls, each wrapped as {data: {...}, id}; the response's meta.count holds the total.

get_call.title: Get a call
get_call.description: Get one call by id with its full detail: status, visitor number, manager and caller id, billing time, rating, tags, notes, form fields (call_request_fields with their field ids), referer, UTM and geo data. Use list_calls to find call ids.
get_call.notes: The API key needs the calls.view scope.

output.description: The `data` member of CallPage's response envelope.

update_call_field.title: Update a call's field value
update_call_field.description: Set or update the value of one form field on a call, e.g. a rating or a custom field the visitor filled in. Field ids are the `id`s under call_request_fields in get_call.

field_id.description: Id of the field (from call_request_fields in get_call).

value.description: New value for the field (string, number or boolean as text).

output.description: The `data` member of CallPage's response envelope.

list_users.title: List users
list_users.description: List the account's users (owner, admins and managers) with id, name, email, phone, role and caller id. Requires no scope: it works with the token user's own permissions. User ids from here are what the widget and manager tools take.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (CallPage default 100).

output.description: The users in `data`, with `meta` holding offset, limit and the total count.

get_user.title: Get a user
get_user.description: Get one user by id, or by email address instead, with name, phone, role, last online time and caller id.

id.description: User identifier, as listed by list_users (also shown in the dashboard's users tab).

email.description: The user's email address; use instead of id.

output.description: The `data` member of CallPage's response envelope.

create_user.title: Create a user
create_user.description: Create a user who can answer calls. Users without an email are call operators only (no dashboard login, not counted against the subscription); users with an email can sign in according to their role. Returns the new user's id; then attach them to a widget with add_users_to_widget or create_manager.

tel.description: Phone number in E.164 format, e.g. +48123123123.

email.description: Valid email address; omit for an operator-only user.

role.description: Role of the user (CallPage default manager).

output.description: The `data` member of CallPage's response envelope.

update_user.title: Update a user
update_user.description: Update a user's name, phone number, email and role by id. Depending on who makes the request this can also change the user's parent user.

id.description: User identifier, as listed by list_users (also shown in the dashboard's users tab).

tel.description: Phone number in E.164 format, e.g. +48123123123.

output.description: The `data` member of CallPage's response envelope.

delete_user.title: Delete a user
delete_user.description: Permanently delete a user account by id. To only detach a user from one widget, use delete_manager instead.

id.description: User identifier, as listed by list_users (also shown in the dashboard's users tab).

output.description: The `data` member of CallPage's response envelope.

list_widgets.title: List widgets
list_widgets.description: List the account's callback widgets with id, description, website URL, enabled flag, language, installation status, SMS sender name, call request count and their managers (with departments and business times). Widget ids are what nearly every other CallPage tool takes.
list_widgets.notes: The API key needs the widgets.view scope.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (CallPage default 100).

output.description: The widgets in `data`, with `meta` holding offset, limit and the total count.

get_widget.title: Get a widget
get_widget.description: Get one widget by id with its settings summary, managers, their departments (ids and names) and business times. Department and manager ids from here can be passed to call_visitor.
get_widget.notes: The API key needs the widgets.view scope.

widget_id.description: Widget identifier, as listed by list_widgets (also shown in the dashboard's widgets tab).

output.description: The `data` member of CallPage's response envelope.

call_visitor.title: Call a phone number now
call_visitor.description: Place a callback through a widget: CallPage rings the widget's available managers (or one department, or one manager) and connects them to `tel`. If no manager is available a scheduled call is created instead. The call is real and costs call minutes. Use call_or_schedule to book the first available slot explicitly.
call_visitor.notes: The API key needs the widgets.call scope. Places a real phone call.

id.description: Widget identifier, as listed by list_widgets (also shown in the dashboard's widgets tab).

tel.description: Number to call, Phone number in E.164 format, e.g. +48123123123.

department_id.description: Only ring managers in this department (see get_widget). Cannot be combined with manager_id.

manager_id.description: Only ring this manager. Cannot be combined with department_id.

output.description: The `data` member of CallPage's response envelope.

call_or_schedule.title: Call now or schedule
call_or_schedule.description: Ring the widget's available managers (optionally one department) and connect them to `tel`; if nobody is available, schedule the call on the first available slot. Returns the call request id; follow it with get_call or list_calls.
call_or_schedule.notes: The API key needs the widgets.call scope. Places a real phone call.

id.description: Widget identifier, as listed by list_widgets (also shown in the dashboard's widgets tab).

tel.description: Number to call, Phone number in E.164 format, e.g. +48123123123.

department_id.description: Only ring managers in this department (see get_widget).

output.description: The `data` member of CallPage's response envelope.

create_widget.title: Create a widget
create_widget.description: Create a callback widget for a website URL, add the token user as its manager, and return the new widget's id. Configure it further with update_widget and add_users_to_widget.
create_widget.notes: The API key needs the widgets.edit scope.

url.description: Website URL where the widget will be installed, e.g. https://callpage.io.

description.description: Description of the widget (CallPage default: 'Created from REST API. Timestamp: ...').

output.description: The `data` member of CallPage's response envelope.

update_widget.title: Update a widget
update_widget.description: Update a widget's URL, description, language, enabled flag and settings. `settings` takes the documented setting keys: callerId (0 CallPage number, 1 every manager's number, 2 single number), countdown (28-59), call.algorithm (simulring|findme), call.recording, call.direction (ab|ba), call.from, widget.showMobile, widget.hideAfterHourss, widget.enableSmsName, widget.playSound, widget.showScheduled, widget.showCallStats, widget.showHint, widget.showFlags, widget.style.position, widget.style.scheme, widget.style.color, widget.button.autoShow, widget.button.showTimeout, widget.button.showManagersCount, etc.allowRecording.
update_widget.notes: The API key needs the widgets.edit scope.

id.description: Widget identifier, as listed by list_widgets (also shown in the dashboard's widgets tab).

url.description: Website URL where the widget is installed.

settings.description: Widget settings keyed by the setting names listed in the tool description, e.g. {"call.recording": true, "widget.style.position": "bottom-left"}.

output.description: The `data` member of CallPage's response envelope.

delete_widget.title: Delete a widget
delete_widget.description: Permanently delete a widget by id; it stops working on the website it was installed on.
delete_widget.notes: The API key needs the widgets.edit scope.

id.description: Widget identifier, as listed by list_widgets (also shown in the dashboard's widgets tab).

output.description: The `data` member of CallPage's response envelope.

add_users_to_widget.title: Add users to a widget
add_users_to_widget.description: Make one or more users managers of a widget, each with optional working hours. Existing user/widget pairs are updated instead. Returns the user_id/manager_id pairs. Use create_manager to add a single manager with an enabled flag.
add_users_to_widget.notes: The API key needs the widgets.edit scope.

id.description: Widget identifier, as listed by list_widgets (also shown in the dashboard's widgets tab).

business_times.description: One business-times array per user_id, in the same order; each is seven day objects {day_of_week 0-6 (Sunday first), enabled, start_time 'HH:MM', end_time 'HH:MM'}. Omit for the default 9:00-17:00 Monday-Friday.

output.description: The `data` member of CallPage's response envelope.

list_managers.title: List a widget's managers
list_managers.description: List the managers (users who answer calls) of one widget with their user details, enabled flag, departments and weekly business times.
list_managers.notes: The API key needs the managers.view and widgets.view scopes.

widget_id.description: Widget identifier, as listed by list_widgets (also shown in the dashboard's widgets tab).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (CallPage default 100).

output.description: The managers in `data`, with `meta` holding offset, limit and the total count.

get_manager.title: Get a manager
get_manager.description: Get the manager record linking a user to a widget: enabled flag, departments and business times.
get_manager.notes: The API key needs the managers.view and widgets.view scopes.

user_id.description: User identifier, as listed by list_users (also shown in the dashboard's users tab).

widget_id.description: Widget identifier, as listed by list_widgets (also shown in the dashboard's widgets tab).

output.description: The `data` member of CallPage's response envelope.

create_manager.title: Create a manager
create_manager.description: Make a user a manager of a widget, with an enabled flag (whether CallPage rings them) and weekly business times. Returns the manager id.
create_manager.notes: The API key needs the managers.edit and widgets.edit scopes.

user_id.description: User identifier, as listed by list_users (also shown in the dashboard's users tab).

widget_id.description: Widget identifier, as listed by list_widgets (also shown in the dashboard's widgets tab).

enabled.description: Whether CallPage should ring this manager (CallPage default true).

business_times.description: Manager's working hours: seven objects, Sunday (day_of_week 0) to Saturday (6), each {day_of_week, enabled, start_time 'HH:MM', end_time 'HH:MM', timezone?}. Timezone defaults to Europe/Warsaw. Omit for the default 9:00-17:00 Monday-Friday.

output.description: The `data` member of CallPage's response envelope.

update_manager.title: Update a manager
update_manager.description: Update a widget manager's enabled flag and weekly business times, identified by user_id and widget_id.
update_manager.notes: The API key needs the managers.edit and widgets.edit scopes.

user_id.description: User identifier, as listed by list_users (also shown in the dashboard's users tab).

widget_id.description: Widget identifier, as listed by list_widgets (also shown in the dashboard's widgets tab).

enabled.description: Whether CallPage should ring this manager.

business_times.description: Manager's working hours: seven objects, Sunday (day_of_week 0) to Saturday (6), each {day_of_week, enabled, start_time 'HH:MM', end_time 'HH:MM', timezone?}. Timezone defaults to Europe/Warsaw. Omit for the default 9:00-17:00 Monday-Friday.

output.description: The `data` member of CallPage's response envelope.

delete_manager.title: Delete a manager
delete_manager.description: Remove a user from a widget's managers; the user account itself remains (use delete_user to remove it).
delete_manager.notes: The API key needs the managers.edit and widgets.edit scopes.

user_id.description: User identifier, as listed by list_users (also shown in the dashboard's users tab).

widget_id.description: Widget identifier, as listed by list_widgets (also shown in the dashboard's widgets tab).

output.description: The `data` member of CallPage's response envelope.

list_voice_messages.title: List voice messages
list_voice_messages.description: List a widget's voice messages: the greeting played to the manager on pickup (manager.call) and to the visitor (visitor.call), each with enabled flag and recording URL. Defaults (Polish or English, by widget locale) are returned when no custom message exists.
list_voice_messages.notes: The API key needs the voice.view and widgets.view scopes.

widget_id.description: Widget identifier, as listed by list_widgets (also shown in the dashboard's widgets tab).

output.description: The voice messages.

create_voice_message.title: Create a custom voice message
create_voice_message.description: Create a custom voice message for a widget from an audio file URL (.mp3, .mpga or .wav, max 10 MB). Use update_voice_message once a custom message exists.
create_voice_message.notes: The API key needs the voice.edit and widgets.edit scopes.

widget_id.description: Widget identifier, as listed by list_widgets (also shown in the dashboard's widgets tab).

file.description: URL of the audio recording (.mp3, .mpga or .wav, max 10 MB).

output.description: The `data` member of CallPage's response envelope.

update_voice_message.title: Update a custom voice message
update_voice_message.description: Update an existing custom voice message's enabled flag or recording URL. Default messages cannot be updated; create a custom one first with create_voice_message.
update_voice_message.notes: The API key needs the voice.edit and widgets.edit scopes.

widget_id.description: Widget identifier, as listed by list_widgets (also shown in the dashboard's widgets tab).

file.description: URL of the audio recording (.mp3, .mpga or .wav, max 10 MB).

output.description: The `data` member of CallPage's response envelope.

reset_voice_message.title: Reset voice messages
reset_voice_message.description: Discard a widget's custom voice message and revert to the default; with no message_id, every voice message of the widget is reset.
reset_voice_message.notes: The API key needs the voice.edit and widgets.edit scopes.

widget_id.description: Widget identifier, as listed by list_widgets (also shown in the dashboard's widgets tab).

message_id.description: Message to reset; omit to reset all.

output.description: The `data` member of CallPage's response envelope.

list_sms_messages.title: List SMS messages
list_sms_messages.description: List a widget's SMS templates (visitor.dial-completed, visitor.call-scheduled, manager.call-completed, user.missed-call-complaint) with text and enabled flag. Defaults in the widget's language are returned where no custom SMS exists.
list_sms_messages.notes: The API key needs the sms.view and widgets.view scopes.

widget_id.description: Widget identifier, as listed by list_widgets (also shown in the dashboard's widgets tab).

output.description: The SMS templates.

create_sms_message.title: Create a custom SMS
create_sms_message.description: Create a custom SMS template for a widget, replacing the default text for that message. Use update_sms_message once a custom SMS exists.
create_sms_message.notes: The API key needs the sms.edit and widgets.edit scopes.

widget_id.description: Widget identifier, as listed by list_widgets (also shown in the dashboard's widgets tab).

text.description: SMS text, at most 240 characters. May use the variables :company_name, :name (manager's name), :tel and :url.

enabled.description: Whether the SMS is sent (CallPage default true).

output.description: The `data` member of CallPage's response envelope.

update_sms_message.title: Update a custom SMS
update_sms_message.description: Update an existing custom SMS template's text or enabled flag. Default SMSs cannot be updated; create a custom one first with create_sms_message.
update_sms_message.notes: The API key needs the sms.edit and widgets.edit scopes.

widget_id.description: Widget identifier, as listed by list_widgets (also shown in the dashboard's widgets tab).

text.description: SMS text, at most 240 characters. May use the variables :company_name, :name (manager's name), :tel and :url.

output.description: The `data` member of CallPage's response envelope.

reset_sms_message.title: Reset SMS messages
reset_sms_message.description: Discard a widget's custom SMS and revert to the default text; with no message_id, every SMS of the widget is reset.
reset_sms_message.notes: The API key needs the sms.edit and widgets.edit scopes.

widget_id.description: Widget identifier, as listed by list_widgets (also shown in the dashboard's widgets tab).

message_id.description: SMS to reset; omit to reset all.

output.description: The `data` member of CallPage's response envelope.
